1.w: For the music director, according to the al-tashcheth style; a prayer of David, written when Saul sent men to surround his house and murder him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Protect me from those who attack me.

2.w: Deliver me from evildoers. Rescue me from violent men.

3.w: For look, they wait to ambush me; powerful men stalk me, but not because I have rebelled or sinned, O Lord.

4.w: Though I have done nothing wrong, they are anxious to attack. Spring into action and help me. Take notice of me.

5.w: You, O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself and punish all the nations. Have no mercy on any treacherous evildoers. (Selah)

6.w: They return in the evening; they growl like dogs and prowl around outside the city.

7.w: Look, they hurl insults at me and openly threaten to kill me, for they say, “Who hears?”

8.w: But you, O Lord, laugh in disgust at them; you taunt all the nations.

9.w: You are my source of strength. I will wait for you. For God is my refuge.

10.w: The God who loves me will help me; God will enable me to triumph over my enemies.

11.w: Do not strike them dead suddenly, because then my people might forget the lesson. Use your power to make them homeless vagabonds and then bring them down, O Lord who shields us.

12.w: They speak sinful words. So let them be trapped by their own pride and by the curses and lies they speak.

13.w: Angrily wipe them out. Wipe them out so they vanish. Let them know that God rules over Jacob and to the ends of the earth. (Selah)

14.w: They return in the evening; they growl like dogs and prowl around outside the city.

15.w: They wander around looking for something to eat; they refuse to sleep until they are full.

16.w: As for me, I will sing about your strength; I will praise your loyal love in the morning. For you are my refuge and my place of shelter when I face trouble.

17.w: You are my source of strength. I will sing praises to you. For God is my refuge, the God who loves me.
